# Supabase Files

* .env
* `config.toml`: Supabase CLI project config, generated by `supabase init`.
* `migrations/`: SQL that creates the database schema. `20261108034532_create_food_tables.sql` creates `food_db` and `food_json`, the tables `apps/scraper/ingest_food.py` writes to.

## Apply the migrations

From the repository root, link this folder to your Supabase project once, then push the migrations:

```bash
npx supabase login
npx supabase link --project-ref <project-ref>
npx supabase db push
```

`<project-ref>` is the ID in your project's dashboard URL: `https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/<project-ref>`.

To add a schema change later, create a new migration instead of editing an applied one:

```bash
npx supabase migration new <name>
```
